description: This file defines the Route class in the Slim Framework, responsible for handling route configurations, including HTTP methods, pattern, callable actions, middleware, and request handling logic.

classes.name: Route
classes.description: Represents a route in the Slim Framework, encapsulating HTTP methods, pattern, callable action, middleware, and request handling logic. Implements the RouteInterface and RequestHandlerInterface, facilitating route registration and execution.

methods.name: getCallableResolver
methods.description: Returns the callable resolver instance used to resolve route callables.

methods.name: getInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Returns the current invocation strategy for route callables.

methods.name: setInvocationStrategy
methods.description: Sets a new invocation strategy for the route.

methods.name: getMethods
methods.description: Retrieves the list of HTTP methods supported by this route.

methods.name: getPattern
methods.description: Returns the route pattern string.

methods.name: setPattern
methods.description: Sets a new pattern for the route.

methods.name: getCallable
methods.description: Returns the callable associated with the route.

methods.name: setCallable
methods.description: Assigns a new callable to the route.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the route.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets a name for the route.

methods.name: getIdentifier
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier for the route.

methods.name: getArgument
methods.description: Retrieves a specific argument's value by name, with optional default.

methods.name: getArguments
methods.description: Returns all arguments associated with the route.

methods.name: setArguments
methods.description: Sets the arguments for the route, optionally including in saved arguments.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds middleware to the route's dispatcher.

methods.name: addMiddleware
methods.description: Adds a middleware instance to the route.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares route arguments by merging saved and new arguments.

methods.name: setArgument
methods.description: Sets a single argument value, optionally including it in saved arguments.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes the route, applying middleware and returning a response.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles a request by resolving and executing the route's callable with the proper invocation strategy.
